general_information.Description: Main objective: This course aims to equip students with the skills to manage resources, administer assets and familiar with several key procedures of housekeeping cleanliness process. -Description: Housekeeping management examines the role of supervisory function in housekeeping management such as inventory & equipment management, characteristics of materials, linen & laundry management, cleaning functions, the technical details of cleaning a room and control of supplies and equipment. -Teaching method: lecture, discussion, demonstration, roleplay, project based learning, group work - Facility and equipment requirement : Depending on the training condition of each campus, the course will be implemented in school lab designed up to 4-5* hotel standard, real hotel or other places, which fully met with requirements. -Completion Criteria: Every on-going assessment component > 0; Final Result >=5 & Final Exam Score >= 4
general_information.StudentTasks: Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Comply with the time and regulation - Professional grooming - Respect and protect school asset. - Strongly communication and teamworking.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: To describe the role of the housekeeping department in hotel operations, and explain the importance of effective communication between housekeeping department and other departments
To list and describe criteria for selection of materials and equipment for the hotel, for example, walls, floorings, beddings, linen, carpets, etc.
To operate the key procedure of cleaning and inspecting guest rooms, public areas and others, as well as able to demonstrate a working knowledge of the procedures.
To explain usage of various tools used to plan and organize the housekeeping department – staffing guide, area inventory lists, frequency schedules, performance standards and productivity standards.
To utilize various techniques to manage inventories effectively
To utilize various methods to control expenses in the housekeeping department
To operate the method of protecting property from damage and risk of insect
To demonstrate highly cooperation and discipline the team, instructor and school regulation
To communicate english fluently and professtionally in working place
To understand the responsibility of executive housekeeping and how to manage efficiently deparmental human resource
